languages.intro: We translate between English, French, Arabic and Chinese in any combination. Whether your documents are in Arabic and your university needs Chinese, or you have French transcripts that need to reach an English-medium programme — we cover it.

process.intro: No portals, no sign-ups, no credit cards. Send us the document, wait a day, get it back — that's the whole process.

one.title: Send us your document
one.body: Message us on WhatsApp with a clear photo or scan of each document, the source and target language, and which university you're applying to.

two.title: We translate and format
two.body: Our translator works through your document, matching names, grades and dates against the standards Chinese universities expect. Layout, stamps and signatures stay intact.

three.title: Receive it ready to submit
three.body: You get a clean, application-ready PDF — formatted to be attached directly to your university application or uploaded to a visa portal.

whyUs.intro: Plenty of translators can turn your diploma into Chinese. Fewer know what a Chinese admissions officer actually wants to see when they open the PDF. We sit on both sides of that table.

expertise.title: We know what Chinese universities expect
expertise.body: We're part of China Global Study. We help students apply to Chinese universities every year — we know which documents the admissions office wants, how names should be rendered and where most translations go wrong.

format.title: Formatted to look like the original
format.body: Your translated document preserves the layout, stamps, signatures and seals of the original. Admissions officers can line them up side by side and match every field at a glance.

human.title: Handled by humans, not software
human.body: Machine translation gets names, grading scales and official titles wrong in ways that cost students admission. A real translator reads every page and checks it end to end.

time.title: 24 hours, reliably
time.body: Application deadlines don't wait. We commit to a 24-hour standard turnaround so you can plan your submission, not chase a translator.

hero.intro: A focused service: the core paperwork for Chinese university applications, translated between English, French, Arabic and Chinese, delivered in 24 hours.

diploma.title: High school diploma
diploma.desc: The single most-requested document for bachelor's applications. We translate graduation certificates in full — national headers, school seals, signatures and footers — so the translated version looks and reads like the original.
included: Student name, date of birth, place of birth
School name, address and accreditation references
Graduation date and academic year
Signatures, stamps and official seals noted and preserved
Translator's statement on letterhead

transcript.title: Academic transcript
transcript.desc: Semester-by-semester or cumulative transcripts. We match subject names to internationally recognised equivalents, keep grading scales intact, and render credit hours in a way Chinese universities can compare against their own systems.
included: All subjects with exact course titles
Grades as given, with an explanation of the scale
Credit hours or weekly periods
Academic term structure (semesters, years)
Class rank or GPA if present

certificate.title: School certificate
certificate.desc: Enrolment letters, attendance records, completion certificates and certified school statements. Typically used alongside a transcript to prove current or recent student status.
included: Type of certificate (enrolment, attendance, completion)
Student details and dates of enrolment
Signing authority and their role
School letterhead and stamps
Any accompanying academic notes

criminal.title: Criminal record / good-conduct certificate
criminal.desc: Required for the Chinese student visa file. We translate police-issued certificates of good conduct carefully — names and ID numbers are sensitive, and even small errors hold up a visa.
included: Full legal name as shown on the original
National ID or passport number
Issuing authority and stamp
Statement of clear / non-clear record as issued
Date of issue and validity period if present

more.title: Other documents for your application
more.body: Passport copies, motivation letters, recommendation letters, medical certificates, bank statements — if it's part of a Chinese university application, ask us.

hero.intro: No portals to sign up for, no credit cards to enter. You send, we translate, you receive. Here's how the day actually looks.

sla.title: Our 24-hour turnaround, in detail
sla.body: Standard documents — transcripts, diplomas, school certificates, criminal records — are delivered within 24 hours of quote approval. We work in Morocco time (GMT+1), so a document approved Monday morning is back by Tuesday morning. Bigger files, stacks of transcripts or urgent rush jobs are quoted case by case, and we always tell you up front if a deadline is tight.

scan.title: How to send a clean scan

items.title: Good lighting
items.body: Daylight, or bright even indoor light. No shadows across the page.

items.title: All four corners visible
items.body: Cropped to show every edge of the document. Stamps half-cut-off cost an extra day.

items.title: Seals and signatures readable
items.body: If a seal looks blurry in the photo, it'll be unreadable in the translation.

items.title: One page per image
items.body: Clearer than multi-page phone photos. Or a proper PDF scan if you have access to one.

deliverable.title: What you get back
deliverable.body: A PDF formatted to match the original — same layout, same section order, with Chinese / English / Arabic / French text where the original text was. A translator's statement is included, confirming that the translation is a true and accurate rendering of the original. Every page is on our letterhead with contact details, so the admissions office can verify us if they choose to.

items.a: Our translations are not sworn or state-certified, but they are accepted by Chinese universities — which is what matters for a student application. Every translated document is on our letterhead and carries a statement confirming it is a true and accurate rendering of the original. If your university specifically requires a notarised or sworn translation, let us know before we start.

items.q: How much does a translation cost?
items.a: We price per document, based on language pair, length and complexity. A short school certificate is not the same job as a 20-page university record. Send us your documents on WhatsApp and we'll come back with a flat quote within a few hours — no surprise fees later.

Yes, for standard documents like transcripts, diplomas, school certificates and criminal records. We start as soon as the quote is approved. For unusually long or urgent cases, we'll tell you up front — we don't promise what we can't deliver.
A clean, application-ready PDF formatted to match your original document. You can submit it directly through university portals or attach it to your visa file.

items.q: How do I send my documents?
items.a: The easiest way is WhatsApp — send a clear photo or scan of each page. You can also email them. Make sure every seal, signature and stamp is visible in the scan; a translated document can only be as clear as the original we're reading from.

items.q: Can you translate documents for countries other than China?
items.a: Right now we focus on translations for Chinese university applications — that's where our expertise lies and where we can guarantee acceptance. If your needs are different, message us and we'll tell you honestly whether we're the right fit.

hero.intro: CGS Language Services is the translation division of China Global Study — the agency that helps students from Morocco, North Africa and beyond apply to universities in China.

story.title: Why we exist
story.p1: Every year, we watched our own students get their application documents translated by outside agencies — and every year, we watched the same mistakes come back: misspelled names, grading scales rendered incorrectly, stamps left out, certificates that looked nothing like the original.
story.p2: Most of those mistakes are invisible to a general translator. They only matter to someone who has read hundreds of Chinese university application files and knows exactly what an admissions officer flags. So we built the translation in-house.
story.p3: Today we offer that same work to any student applying to a Chinese university, not just our own. Same quality, same 24-hour turnaround, same quiet attention to the details that decide admissions.

parent.title: Part of China Global Study
parent.body: China Global Study helps students worldwide access China's top universities — from language programmes to PhDs. CGS Language Services handles the document side of that work: the translations that sit quietly in the background of every successful application.

items.title: Getting it right the first time
items.body: An application deadline is not the place to discover a typo. We proofread every translation against the original, twice.

items.title: Keeping deadlines
items.body: 24 hours means 24 hours. If we can't, we say so before we start.

items.title: Treating documents like what they are
items.body: Your transcripts and certificates are the result of years of work. We handle them with that kind of care.
